title: The board feed kept every change between reads, so a long healthy stream grew without bound
resolution: Changes are kept only while a read runs, and a read that falls 1,000 changes behind the stream is replaced by a resync.

title: A late 401 of a request sent before a logout could end the session of a later login
resolution: Each board request takes the expiry of the session view it started under, which does nothing once a newer view showed.

title: Repeated resyncs read the board and opened a stream again at once without a limit
resolution: A first resync recovers at once; each further one before a change waits from 1 s, doubled up to 10 s, and stopping cancels it.

title: The lost-updates notice disappeared when a new stream started to connect, before it opened
resolution: A failed stream or a resync keeps the liveness lost through the re-read and the new connection until the stream opens.

title: The sideways scroll viewport of the columns took no keyboard focus
resolution: The viewport gets tabIndex 0 and is a region named Board columns through the Mantine viewportProps.

title: The loading states spun their loader under reduced motion
resolution: Under reduced motion the loading states keep their status text and leave the loader out.

title: Project pagination caught only a page that named itself as the next one, not a cycle
resolution: The adapter keeps every followed cursor and reads a page that names one of them as unreachable.

title: The record credited both verify runs with the web test results that only the second run had
resolution: The evidence check credits the web results and coverage to the second run only.
